INTO CANADA'S TERRITORIAL AIRSPACE MAY APPLY TO THE MINISTER OF 
TRANSPORT AT 1-877-992-6853 OR 1-613-992-6853 OR BY EMAIL AT 
OPERATIONS.AVIATION(AT)TC.GC.CA.
